title: Spreadsheet Reasoning Inspector
dek: Formuloom is a pipeline I built in Python that sorts a spreadsheet's changed cells into final outputs, the values someone would report, and intermediates, the working steps. Rebuilt here on one small workbook: rules vote on each cell over its dependency graph, scored against an answer key.
summary: Rules vote on which spreadsheet values are final: balanced voting marks a scratch cell final, and a stricter gate finds neither real result.
